name: Ground: deep coral
when: Behind a full-screen graphic heavy with white text, when the scene has no shot of its own to blur: the flat ground where white text stands out most.
anchor: None of its own: it starts and ends with the full-screen graphic on top.

vars.out: seconds: the ground's length, the same as the full-screen graphic on top (make_scene sets the scene's length from it)

placement: Mount it under a full-screen graphic (layer fullscreen) with the same --start, and set out to the graphic's length. Its host goes below the graphic's host in z-index.
changed: The lab drew the ground inside each full-screen scene (one CSS preset for all of them); here it is its own scene, mounted under the graphic. The lab also tinted the cards' shadows on this ground (rgba(64, 8, 28, a) instead of black): shadows belong to the graphic on top, so they are not part of this template. In the lab the article scene faded in over 0.27 s together with its ground; here the ground is simply cut in and the graphic on top does its own entry. The dither grain (lab tools/make_grain.py, seed 1906) is rebuilt inside the template pixel for pixel on a canvas, so no grain file is needed.
